evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES improved 8.1 percentage points from t-3w to t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC mean over next 28 days does not exceed RETAIL_REC mean over prior 28 days, or WORKPLACES reverses to decline in week t+1.

mechanism_narrative: Declining RESIDENTIAL mobility (from 14.6% to 10.1% over 3 weeks) indicates people spending less time at home and more time outside. This behavioral shift toward outdoor and retail activity directly increases RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL declined 4.5 percentage points from t-3w to t-0w
